review_evidence: Packet-bound independent review of ASTIS-REVIEW-ff861ff1f7ab123f. Specialization to finite-dimensional Euclidean space yields the full stated source conclusion for every beta>=0, including zero. The arbitrary-Hilbert-space result is a disclosed ASTIS generalization, not literal source equivalence. The beta upper model implies the beta+epsilon model for epsilon>0. Add the two ordered Bregman estimates: 2||d||^2<=2(beta+epsilon)<d,y-x>. Divide by 2 and take epsilon down to zero by continuity and closed order. This works regardless of the sign of the pairing and retains beta=0.
